literature_comparability.question: Are these definitions, outcomes, populations, controls and datasets comparable enough to combine, and if so under what dependency cap?

exact_unresolved_pro_choices: Which exact sector geometry and planet/profession pairs define the candidate.
Which athlete/profession admission and eminence rules are legitimate.
Which papers reuse Gauquelin, CSICOP, CFEPP or derived records and therefore count once.
Whether selection-bias explanations or failed replications outweigh reported excesses.
Whether heterogeneous profession and sector outcomes are comparable enough to combine.
What control generator and dependency/corroboration caps are required.

literature_comparability.question: Are these definitions, outcomes, populations, controls and datasets comparable enough to combine, and if so under what dependency cap?

exact_unresolved_pro_choices: Whether any aspect-to-trait mapping is credible enough to freeze before outcome access.
Whether tightness, applying/separating or angularity enter only as moderators or not at all.
Which aspect angles, body pairs, orbs, angular axes and trait outcomes define the feature universe.
Whether continuous distance is preferable to thresholded orbs.
How family-wise multiplicity and correlated interactions are controlled.
Whether heterogeneous mundane, medical, vocation and personality studies may be combined (mechanically they are not commensurate).
